urls.title: Feeds or websites
urls.description: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed URLs, or plain website addresses (stackoverflow.blog): the feed is found from the page's <link rel="alternate"> tag or the usual paths (/feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml...). Works for blogs, news sites, Medium (medium.com/feed/@name), podcasts and job boards. Up to 5,000 per run.

publishedAfter.title: Only items published after
publishedAfter.description: A date (2026-11-01) or a period back from now (24 hours, 7 days, 2 weeks). Items without a date are skipped when this is set. Leave empty for all items.

keywords.title: Only items mentioning
keywords.description: Keep items whose title, summary, categories or text contain at least one of these words (case and accents ignored). Matches are listed in matchedKeywords.

excludeKeywords.title: Skip items mentioning
excludeKeywords.description: Drop items that contain any of these words.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Maximum items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Newest items first. Most feeds hold 10 to 50 items; podcasts can hold thousands of episodes.

maxItems.title: Maximum items in total
maxItems.description: Stop the run after this many items across all feeds.

content.title: Full content
content.description: Add the full article text (when the feed includes it, as WordPress, Medium and most blogs do) in a 'content' field, as plain text (good for AI and RAG) or the original HTML.

summaryMaxLength.title: Summary length (characters)
summaryMaxLength.description: Summaries are cut at a word boundary after this many characters. 0 leaves the summary out.

deduplicate.title: Remove duplicates across feeds
deduplicate.description: The same article in two feeds (same link, ignoring utm_ tracking parameters) is saved once.

allFeedsPerWebsite.title: Read every feed a website declares
allFeedsPerWebsite.description: By default a website gives its main feed only. Turn on to also read category or language feeds the page lists (comment feeds are always skipped).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel feeds
maxConcurrency.description: How many feeds to read at the same time (at most 2 at once per website).
